speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of binucleated cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm in the urine strongly suggests a parasitic infection. Given your recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, did you experience any respiratory symptoms like cough or wheezing, or perhaps a rash? Also, have you noticed any change in your stool habits?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ascending Pyelonephritis due to *Schistosoma haematobium* infection. The presence of binucleated, eosinophilic cells in the urine (schistosomes) combined with flank pain, fever, and sterile pyuria is pathognomonic. I recommend requesting images of the bladder ultrasound to confirm bladder wall thickening and potential calcifications.
